verdict.rationale: Vapi docs explicitly describe HIPAA compliance toggle, organization-wide compliance mode with approved providers and call recording/log storage controls, plus enterprise SSO (Okta/Azure AD/SAML/OIDC) and RBAC, which supports regulated-workload governance. However, there is no mention of SOC 2 certification, BAA execution process, or data-residency options, and no independent/community corroboration of compliance claims. Missing for 10: SOC 2 attestation evidence, explicit BAA signing process, data-residency/region controls, and third-party audit confirmation.
